name: Charles W. Adams
notable_stories: He ended up in a state hospital (insane asylum); death certificate gives cause as exhaustion with insanity as contributory cause. Nativity and birth date confirm he was the son of John Wesley and Mary F. Adams.
locations: Mt. Olivet Cemetery, Marceline, Linn County, MO
sources: Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, compiled by William W. "Bill" Allen (2 April 2011 edition)
Further Research on the Family and Descendants of Joseph P. and Elizabeth (Hamilton) Adams, William W. Allen (February 2012)
notes: Brother of Mary Susan Adams; ended up under psychiatric care [Bill Allen, Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, line 4637]
